svg.title: Library borrowing system - physical ER model
svg.desc: Eight tables with all columns and seven foreign-key relationships. Each child has exactly one parent; each parent has zero or many children. The SQL schema is authoritative.
svg.text: Physical ER model | MySQL 8.0 / 8.4 | Track 1 - Part A
G: stored generated; see open-loan rule below
PK primary key FK foreign key UQ unique key G stored generated AI auto_increment ? nullable
Cardinality: 1 = exactly one parent; 0..* = zero or many child rows. Unmarked columns are NOT NULL.
Open-loan rule: active_copy_id = copy_id when returned_at IS NULL; otherwise NULL. UNIQUE(active_copy_id).
FK actions: RESTRICT; book_authors.book_id uses ON DELETE CASCADE. This does not delete borrowing history.
Dates: due_at > borrowed_at; returned_at IS NULL or returned_at >= borrowed_at. Availability is derived, not duplicated.
Database course project | Part A handoff to B / C / D
